title: Mechanical codes of chemical-scale specificity in DNA motifs.
authors: Chen, Yi-Tsao; Yang, Haw; Chu, Jhih-Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文用统计机器学习解析DNA序列化学尺度力学刚性编码，虽非直接TF-DNA互作建模，但为蛋白-DNA结合界面的力学机制提供可迁移的序列-力学特征方法。
abstract: In gene transcription, certain sequences of double-stranded (ds)DNA play a vital role in nucleosome positioning and expression initiation. That dsDNA is deformed to various extents in these processes leads us to ask: Could the genomic DNA also have sequence specificity in its chemical-scale mechanical properties? We approach this question using statistical machine learning to determine the rigidity between DNA chemical moieties. What emerges for the polyA, polyG, TpA, and CpG sequences studied here is a unique trigram that contains the quantitative mechanical strengths between bases and along the backbone. In a way, such a sequence-dependent trigram could be viewed as a DNA mechanical code. Interestingly, we discover a compensatory competition between the axial base-stacking interaction and the transverse base-pairing interaction, and such a reciprocal relationship constitutes the most discriminating feature of the mechanical code. Our results also provide chemical-scale understanding for experimental observables. For example, the long polyA persistence length is shown to have strong base stacking while its complement (polyA(c)) exhibits high backbone rigidity. The mechanical code concept enables a direct reading of the physical interactions encoded in the sequence which, with further development, is expected to shed new light on DNA allostery and DNA-binding drugs.
abstract_zh: 在基因转录过程中，双链（ds）DNA的特定序列在核小体定位和表达起始中扮演着关键角色。这些过程中双链DNA发生不同程度的形变，引发我们思考：基因组DNA在化学尺度的力学性质上是否也具有序列特异性？我们采用统计机器学习方法来确定DNA化学部分之间的刚性。对于所研究的polyA、polyG、TpA和CpG序列，我们揭示了一个独特的三角组，其中包含了碱基间及骨架上的定量力学强度。在某种程度上，这种序列依赖的三角组可被视为DNA力学密码。有趣的是，我们发现轴向碱基堆积相互作用与横向碱基配对相互作用之间存在补偿性竞争，这种互惠关系构成了力学密码最具区分度的特征。我们的结果还为实验观测提供了化学尺度的理解。例如，长polyA的持久长度显示出强碱基堆积，而其互补链（polyA(c)）则表现出高骨架刚性。力学密码概念使得直接解读序列中编码的物理相互作用成为可能，随着进一步发展，有望为DNA变构和DNA结合药物提供新见解。
